# SmartAIHub

> SmartAIHub is an enterprise AI skill marketplace for reusable skills, virtual workflows, swarm execution, and chat, presentation, image, and video outputs.

Use this file as the LLM-readable navigation index for SmartAIHub public content. Prefer the linked pages for current product, workflow, docs, media, support, and trust information.

## Core Pages

Primary entry points for SmartAIHub visitors and search engines.

- [Home](https://smartaihub.app/): Turn prompts and documents into answers, decks, and videos in one AI workspace.
- [Features](https://smartaihub.app/features): Enterprise capabilities and platform surfaces.
- [Marketplace](https://smartaihub.app/marketplace): Browse skills and reusable capabilities.
- [Pricing](https://smartaihub.app/pricing): Plans and credits for teams and enterprises.
- [Docs](https://smartaihub.app/docs): Guides, FAQs, and technical documentation.
- [Blog](https://smartaihub.app/blog): Tutorials, guides, and product updates.
- [Site Index](https://smartaihub.app/resources): Internal link hub for search and discovery.
- [Contact](https://smartaihub.app/contact): Talk to the SmartAIHub team.

## Docs Clusters

Intent-specific documentation that owns a distinct keyword cluster.

- [Marketplace Discovery](https://smartaihub.app/docs/marketplace-discovery): Find the right skill with strong intent matching.
- [Workflow Builder](https://smartaihub.app/docs/workflow-builder): Turn prompts into repeatable virtual workflows.
- [Swarm Execution](https://smartaihub.app/docs/swarm-execution): Run multiple specialist skills in parallel.
- [Marketplace FAQ](https://smartaihub.app/docs/faq/marketplace): Publishing, governance, and discovery questions.
- [Workflow FAQ](https://smartaihub.app/docs/faq/workflows): Workflow design and orchestration questions.
- [Output FAQ](https://smartaihub.app/docs/faq/outputs): Chat, presentation, and video output packaging.
- [Image Prompt Engineering](https://smartaihub.app/docs/image/prompt-engineering): Brand-safe prompts for AI image generation.
- [Video Production Pipeline](https://smartaihub.app/docs/video/production-pipeline): Scripts, scenes, and production cues.
- [AI Search Optimization](https://smartaihub.app/docs/seo/ai-search-optimization): Improve discoverability for AI and search engines.
- [Content Factory](https://smartaihub.app/docs/content/factory): Skill-generated docs, FAQ, and blog automation.

Pages that target image, video, presentation, and output packaging search intent.
